text.scene: A slightly high, fixed view of a cosy dining room. In the centre of the frame stands a rectangular light oak dining table covered with a shared meal: white plates of pasta and salad, a bowl of bread and glasses of water. Exactly four people sit around the table, each about a third of the frame height, all clearly separated. From left to right: at the left end of the table, on the left side of the frame, a woman with long brown hair in a red sweater sits facing right toward the table; behind the table on its far side, left of centre and a little farther from the camera, a man with short black hair in a blue shirt sits facing the camera, his lower body hidden behind the table top; behind the table on its far side, right of centre and a little farther from the camera, a blonde woman in a yellow blouse sits facing the camera, her lower body hidden behind the table top; at the right end of the table, on the right side of the frame, a grey-haired man in a green jacket sits facing left toward the table. The near side of the table, closest to the camera, is empty.
timeline: Exactly four people stay seated around the table; none leave, merge or are hidden. The woman in the red sweater at the left end chats and laughs while eating pasta; the man in the blue shirt behind the table on the left talks and gestures with his fork; the blonde woman in the yellow blouse behind the table on the right listens, nods and eats salad; the grey-haired man in the green jacket at the right end chats and passes the bread bowl along the table as they share their meal.

Exactly four people stay seated around the table; none leave, merge or are hidden. The woman in the red sweater at the left end talks and gestures toward the others; the man in the blue shirt behind the table on the left laughs and eats a bite of pasta; the blonde woman in the yellow blouse behind the table on the right chats and reaches for bread from the shared meal; the grey-haired man in the green jacket at the right end chats and sips water.

Exactly four people stay seated around the table; none leave, merge or are hidden. The woman in the red sweater at the left end chats and eats salad; the man in the blue shirt behind the table on the left chats and serves himself more food from the shared plates; the blonde woman in the yellow blouse behind the table on the right laughs and talks; the grey-haired man in the green jacket at the right end chats and eats pasta as all four keep sharing their meal.
constraints: Exactly four people, no more and no fewer, all visible for the whole shot.
All four stay seated around the one table; nobody stands up, leaves or enters.
One table with a shared meal of food on it.
Fixed camera, no camera movement; no on-screen text.

intent.expressiveness_reason: The proxies fix the four people around the table and the meal on it; sitting, chatting and eating are carried only by text.

notes: Seated people are approximated by 1.3 m human proxies (seated head height). Classic dining composition: two people at the table ends, two on the far side, near side open to the camera. High camera (4 m) keeps the far-side people mostly above the table top so they are at most ~15% hidden.
